kp5:1.2: at one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Sāvatthi at Anāthapiṇḍika’s grounds in Jeta’s Wood.
kp5:1.3: Then a certain god, at the end of the night, having lit up the whole of Jeta’s Wood with his surpassing beauty, approached the Fortunate One, and after approaching and worshipping the Fortunate One, he stood on one side.
kp5:1.4: While standing on one side that god recited this verse to the Fortunate One:
kp5:2.1: “Many are the gods and the men who have thought about the blessings
kp5:2.4: now please say what is a supreme blessing.”
kp5:4.3: having the right aspiration for oneself: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:5.3: and whatever words are well spoken: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:6.1: Attending on one’s mother and father,
kp5:6.2: looking after one’s wife and sons,
kp5:6.3: having work that is not confusing: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:7.1: Giving, and living by the Dhamma,
kp5:7.3: (performing) actions that are blameless: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:8.2: Abstaining, refraining from bad deeds, restraint from intoxicating drink,
kp5:8.3: being heedful regarding (all) things: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:9.3: listening to the Dhamma at the right time: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:10.1: Being patient and easily spoken to,
kp5:10.3: discussing the Dhamma at the right time: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:11.3: and experiencing Emancipation: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:12.1: He whose mind does not waver,
kp5:12.2: when it is touched by things of this world,
kp5:12.3: being griefless, dustless, and secure: this is a supreme blessing.
kp5:13.4: for them this is a supreme blessing.”
